recording_rules: Do not record private keys, seeds, wallet JSON, credentials, or decrypted secret material.
Every PASS must include timestamp, operator, evidence reference, and non-secret result.
Any mainnet/testnet, genesis, release, image, wallet-scheme, or API-network mismatch is FAIL and aborts startup.

checks.description: Host OS/architecture is in signed RC support matrix.
Docker Engine and Compose versions are supported.
Clock/NTP, disk, inode, memory and CPU prerequisites pass.
Firewall is default-deny and API is not publicly exposed.
Git tag and commit match signed release manifest.
Working tree is clean and immutable release source is used.
Docker image digest matches signed release manifest.
Reviewed normalized configuration hash matches manifest.
Resolved network and chain ID are mainnet.
Genesis hash and frozen consensus parameters match manifest.
Mainnet DB/runtime paths are separate from testnet and contain no wallets.
P2P/API ports and publish hosts match approved topology.
No testnet seed, bootstrap, snapshot, API, Explorer or DNS endpoint exists in mainnet config.
Snapshot trust mode is enforce when snapshot bootstrap is enabled.
Miner wallet is PQ/CHCQ scheme 10 and individually mounted read-only.
Reward owner wallet is PQ/CHCQ scheme 10, distinct, and read-only.
Reward attestation wallet is PQ/CHCQ scheme 10, distinct, and read-only.
Wallet directories are outside runtime, source tree and ordinary backup scope.
Mainnet PQ preflight completes with every check PASS.
Node starts without miner and remains healthy.
API reports mainnet and expected genesis/tip/work.
Peer topology contains only approved mainnet peers.
Startup logs contain no fatal, consensus, DB, wallet, or restart-loop errors.
Miner is enabled only after independent identity/state verification.
Joining node begins from empty DB using full sync or approved trusted snapshot.
Sync progress and peer/network identity are monitored without validation bypass.
Joining node converges on tip/work/supply/UTXO/reward state with independent nodes.
Miner and node are safely stopped for offline DB backup.
DB/WAL/SHM handling, atomic staging and checksum complete.
Ordinary backup excludes all wallets, keys and infrastructure credentials.
Backup checksum and SQLite integrity checks pass in isolated staging runtime.
Restored node P2P-resyncs and converges before mining is enabled.
Snapshot network/genesis/height/tip/work/checksum/signature match trusted manifest.
Snapshot trust mode enforce accepts only pinned signer.
Snapshot artifact contains no wallet, seed, key, credential or log secret.
Restored node delta-syncs and equals full-sync fingerprint.
Evidence is preserved before restart, restore, deletion or configuration change.
Disk-full, peer starvation, stuck sync and crash-loop causes are classified.
DB integrity failure uses preserved copy plus restore/full-sync decision; no manual DB repair.
Emergency miner stop is verified before consensus investigation.
Consensus incident fingerprints independent nodes without DB/tip/UTXO edits.
Compromised bootstrap/API service is isolated and credentials rotated by scope.
Miner key generation, encrypted backups and restore verification are recorded.
Reward owner key custody/backup is distinct from attestation key.
Reward attestation key custody/backup and compromise stop procedure are recorded.
Snapshot signing uses offline custody and trusted public-key distribution.
Infrastructure credentials are environment-separated, scoped and recoverable.
Non-secret logs, hashes, fingerprints and operator approvals are archived.
No mainnet faucet is configured or documented.
